verdict.rationale: Raygun is a monitoring/error-tracking product with alerting rules (ignore conditions, notification integrations) and an AI-assisted resolution chat, but there is no evidence of autonomous background automations/agents that run tasks independently—AI resolution appears to be an interactive chat tool, not an autonomous agent. Missing for 10: evidence of scheduled/triggered autonomous workflows, agentic task execution without human prompting, or any 'automation' feature beyond notification rules.
